data.title: Update on PayPal Service Restoration in Certain Regions
data.brief: Dear Endministrator, PayPal payment services have been restored in certain regions. Thank you for yo
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

PayPal payment services have been restored in certain regions. Thank you for your patience and understanding. As of May 20 at 11:00 (GMT+8), services have officially resumed in the following regions:


Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, France, Germany, Hong Kong SAR, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States, etc.

To ensure a stable service recovery, we have currently enabled the PayPal option only for the countries and regions listed above. If you do not see the PayPal icon during checkout, your region may not yet be included in this phase of the restoration plan. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and patience.


We always prioritize the security and privacy of your transactions. If you have any questions or encounter any technical issues while using our services, feel free to contact our official customer support at any time (via in-game [Settings] - [Platform & Account] - [Contact Customer Support]). We will assist you promptly.


Thank you once again to all Endministrators for your continuous support of Arknights: Endfield. We will continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience.
